public_definitions: goal: Review the clean-generation contribution dashboard, identify the clean-generation source with the largest contribution, then send that source into priority contribution review. Leave any source not meeting the routing threshold out of the priority queue.
comparison_scope: The clean-generation sources listed in the dashboard: Utility solar, Offshore wind, Hydro storage, Bioenergy, and Geothermal heat.

rules: The source with the largest contribution (highest percentage) must be selected for priority review. Any source not meeting the routing threshold (implied to be the largest contribution) is excluded from the priority queue.
